target.title: test(gateway): consolidate agent event fixtures
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The 5,197-line Gateway agent-event suite repeated event construction, chat-run registration, session fixtures, and broadcast setup throughout the file. That boilerplate made the lifecycle and routing assertions harder to review and kept the file substantially above the repository's line-count budget.

## Why This Change Was Made

This maintainer-commissioned, AI-assisted refactor introduces a colocated agent-event fixture helper, moves every event and chat-run setup onto the builders, and table-drives only cases with the same assertion shape. Semantically distinct lifecycle, persistence, throttling, and routing cases remain separate.

No production behavior, config/environment surface, SQLite schema, protocol, snapshot, inventory, baseline, or changelog changed.

## User Impact

No user-visible impact. The same Gateway agent-event behaviors remain covered with less duplicated test setup and clearer failure attribution.

## Evidence

- LOC: test `+991/-1779`, production `+0/-0`, net `-788` lines (15.2%); target file `5,197 -> 4,351` lines plus a 58-line colocated helper.
- Test count before: 129 passing.
- Test count after: 129 passing.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-chat.agent-events.test.ts` — 1 file and 129 tests passed before the refactor, after the refactor, after the accepted autoreview fix, and after rebasing onto current `origin/main`.
- `node scripts/check-changed.mjs -- src/gateway/server-chat.agent-events.test.ts src/gateway/server-chat.agent-events.test-helpers.ts` — passed on Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01ky6hmm9cp1mtxcv01szwy2k0`; run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29978091486.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode uncommitted --stream-engine-output` — final run clean with no accepted/actionable findings after restoring the original optional fallback-sequence semantics.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` — passed after rebase.
